Fig. 2 An overview of the operational steps across various Graph-for-LLM paradigms. Using representative scenarios for each category (e.g., GraphRAG for knowledge injection, or code dependency parsing for domain applications), this figure provides a simplified illustration of how raw data or reasoning states are translated into graph structures, manipulated via graph-specific operations, and finally fed into the LLM to execute or enhance a specific task.
